financial_base.period: FY2027 (ending January 31, 2027), company guidance midpoint issued 2026-08-26
financial_base.normalization_note: GAAP FY2026 diluted EPS was -$0.65 (net loss -$162.5M), distorted by July 2024 outage incident costs and stock-based compensation; P/E on GAAP trailing earnings is not meaningful. Non-GAAP diluted EPS excludes SBC and related payroll taxes, amortization of acquired intangibles, outage-related costs, strategic plan charges, and other items. Q2 FY2027 non-GAAP diluted EPS was $0.31/quarter (earnings release 2026-08-26, vs $0.23 in Q2 FY2026, +34.8% YoY). FY2027 guided non-GAAP diluted EPS range: $1.25-$1.26; midpoint $1.255 used as base. Four-for-one stock split effective after close July 1, 2026; all per-share figures are post-split. Diluted weighted shares ~1.04B. Company does not pay dividends.
